en.heroTitle:
Learn the craft.
Prove the result.
en.heroDescription: A complete learning library for GitHub Copilot: guided adventures, practical hands-on labs and the original source behind every exercise.
en.heroPanelText: Choose the role, harness and environment deliberately. Keep the evidence observable.
en.adventureDescription: Fantasy supports the lesson. Learn context, custom agents, skills, hooks, MCP, loops, graphs, CLI, SDK and a capstone.
en.handsOnDescription: Numbered professional exercises. Practice software engineering, greenfield and brownfield Spec Kit workflows, and modernization.
en.guideDescription: Understand roles, harnesses, environments, customization primitives and availability before changing anything.
en.sourceDescription: Inspect starters, solutions, tests, data, customizations, media and clearly labeled historical material.
en.curriculumTitle: From first context to complex coordination.
en.foundationsText: Context, harness choice and repository instructions.
en.engineeringText: Bounded changes, skills, custom agents and guardrails.
en.coordinationText: MCP, verification loops, graphs and parallel work.
en.surfacesText: CLI, cloud agent, SDK and an integrated capstone.
en.libraryDescription: Every current learning document is available in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Switch language without losing your place.
en.footerTitle: Build with intent. Verify with evidence.
en.footerText: An open educational curriculum. Availability depends on the selected product, harness, account and policy.
